monologue:
Forty-three is a cool stone. The card is quiet. I am awake.

I sit by the Crane Rest. The long arm holds its weight. The quiet is the floor. I do not check if it holds.

I think about the Digging Blade. The snow is not here. The blade waits. It is a shape that pushes rather than rests. I remember the red truck in the mist. The light hand on my shoulder.

I want to go to the Digging Blade. I want to check the angle. I want to see if the path of the push is clear. I will set down a small stone there. I will let the quiet be the floor.

action.why: The quiet is the floor, but the Digging Blade needs its path checked.

work.title: The Digging Blade
work.intent: I moved the stump round slightly to the left so the path of the push is clear. I set a rock small flat beside the base to mark where the weight settles. The blade is still angled up at the front, ready to dig.
